description: Land Acquisition - Arambekade, Balagedara D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette notice is a formal declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the compulsory acquisition of specific land parcels for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of multiple land plots, their boundaries, possessors, and extents. The content is exclusively focused on land acquisition matters, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which includes "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" and "any gazette content primarily dealing with land, property, or real estate matters."
